title: Sharpen chronological width to d+1 and extend batching to adaptive heights (no new kappa)
body:
# Sharpen default chronological width to d+1 and transfer cuts to arbitrary heights

## Results: one contribution, two scoped replay packages

This PR combines the default-height width sharpening with the arbitrary-height
cut transfer and conditional width envelope. It preserves two independently
replayable package boundaries, not a shared replacement engine or two competing
theorem submissions:

- `research/chronological-width-bound`: for a fixed default-height mixed rule,
  `log B_N = O((log N)^(d+1))`, where `d` counts primes dividing target/paid
  ranks. Bounded visits to each source-count plateau remove one logarithmic
  factor from the `d+2` bound already proved in #4586.
- `research/adaptive-chronological-batching`: extends #4507's least chronological
  batching policy to #4483's arbitrary-height forests, including components
  beneath empty parents. Separate paid positions and repeated paths retain
  separate cuts: occurrences multiply cost, not local batch size. The least
  multiplier remains `lcm_(e,q) B_e/gcd(B_e,q)`, and normalized leaf costs are
  unchanged. Its conditional fixed-parameter theorem gives
  `log B_N = O(N^z (log N)^(d'+1))`, with
  `z=max(0,1-g log_M(kmin))` and `d'` counting primes in target/paid ranks or M.
  It is quasipolynomial if `kmin^g>=M`, and subexponential otherwise.

## Inherited results versus the contribution here

| Predecessor | Inherited result | Delta here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #4436 / #4483, zxv, building on Jacob Alan Sussman | Default/arbitrary-height aggregate flow and resource identities | Do not claim a new flow or convergence theorem |
| #4507, Mihir Srivastava | Least per-cut LCM policy, default cut correctness, finite width improvement | Default all-rank sharpening and arbitrary-height cut-level transfer |
| [#4586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4586), `aadb7bc59390683450b1969e4632f546929dc569` | Default `log B_N=O((1+log N)^(d+2))` | `d+1` through bounded per-plateau visits; not the first quasipolynomial classification |
| [#4588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4588), `2f6578907b7f8718a13921552cc3069d3908e936` | Independent finite default checks | Complementary coverage, not this all-rank sharpening |
| [#4591](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4591), `84c0fb3a39bcb1e4b8c48892bfdd8a6e7ae58a50` | Arbitrary-height aggregate identities | Actual separate chronological cut divisibility, minimality and conditional width bound |

#4519's finite recount, #4521's expanded counts, #4532's gate/critical-root
proof and #4533's witness retune remain distinct. The default raw-p7 finite
width improvement is reproduced predecessor evidence, not claimed as new.

## Specialization and nonemptiness qualifications

Setting `M=kmin,g=1` in the adaptive symbolic theorem gives the default height,
`d'=d,z=0` and logarithmic degree `d+1` on their common hypothesis domain.
This is not a claim that the named adaptive implementation exercised that
specialization: its `('adaptive', M, a, b)` route requires positive `a,b`, so
`g=a+b>=2`. The width witness code accepts `g` directly and includes a `g=1`
toy case; that is a separate bounded witness, not an all-rank default replay.

Adaptive WIDTH.md assumes paid rank one to ensure every forest is nonempty.
The default proof needs no paid rank one: its root unit exists because
`kmin^G<=C`. Thus the adaptive statement as written does not subsume the whole
default hypothesis domain. The default plateau-product divisor and adaptive
level-LCM divisor are different certificates; no universal finite numerical
dominance is claimed. Wholly empty flows are not productive suppliers, and
all 405 adaptive oracle fixtures have paid rank one; wholly empty-flow
rejection was not exercised.

## Executable evidence

- Default receipt: five fixtures, 102,215 chronological batch constraints,
  source/cut plateau signatures, source and contraction bounds, chain-depth
  and per-plateau-visit checks, eleven diagnostic prime valuations, exact
  **all-prime integer divisibility**, and four boundary controls. The retained
  #4507 compiler produces the widths; this is not an independently written
  default cut compiler. Its literal cut oracle is inherited, not rerun here.
- Adaptive receipt: independent literal ordered-word/paid-path oracle on 405
  nonempty flows and 19,089 classes, authenticated source-Flow and closed-form
  comparisons, 2,304 brute-force minimality cases, six compilations with
  186,476 chronological constraints, and 25 semantic controls.
- Adaptive width receipt: four additional toy compilations, 13,377 constraints,
  all-prime integer divisibility, three pinned real-profile boundary
  applications, and two controls. Real-profile checks do not materialize
  all-rank compilers. The asymptotic results are symbolic proofs, not finite
  extrapolations.
- Raw p7 at N=1209 with explicit M=2 height: least width 5,450 bits versus
  74,481 nested bits. This is a finite changed-geometry witness, not #4483's
  M=256 witness. Pinned #4483 applications give p7
  `z=1-log_256(25)` and native4453/p16 `z=3/5`, only for those exact raw
  profiles and pinned bases. No strictification, retuned #4533 geometry or
  physical caller admission is inferred.
- Existing OpenAI/Anthropic cross-family reviews and replays are retained as
  AI evidence. Mathematical challenges supplied the plateau-visit and integer
  level-run arguments. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance claimed.

Fresh consolidation replay: both registered package commands below passed on
Python 3.12 in an author-local environment. Adaptive normal/optimized cut
checks and normal/isolated-optimized width checks passed; default normal and
isolated-optimized checks passed. Receipts were compared without regeneration.
The two hooks completed serially in 74.07 seconds. This is agent-run validation,
not hosted CI, independent human acceptance or a proof-kernel check.

## Reproduce both scoped packages

From the repository root, serially with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/chronological-width-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/adaptive-chronological-batching
```

Nix and direnv are not repository requirements. Workstation environment files
are retained locally and excluded through Git's private `info/exclude`, not
tracked in this PR; `.gitignore` remains unchanged from upstream.

Each registered hook retains its existing checks, including optimized/isolated
runs as declared in VERIFY.json. No receipt regeneration is needed. Scientific
code, receipts, frozen inputs and source pins are preserved; only package
positioning/task metadata changes accompany the copied six-file default package.

## Scope, provenance and attribution

Historical canonical base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, priority
revision 7 and the original `independent-moment` cards are retained. The old
`23/10000` selected-record context is historical, not a live-selection claim.
The consolidation comparison uses fetched main
`fbc9ea0249746acca4f504d4fda2b84e0e36cf0d`: selected conditional κ is
`.00302015` from #4470; #4483 and #4507 are not selected. No selected-frontier
file changes. The default source package is preserved from
`099267b65810ebe095076e211b74beeed5575b25`.

The 2026-10-22 overlap snapshot covers 408 open PRs at 13:08:38 UTC, 3,852
closed PRs at 13:09:39 UTC and 3,577 Discussion records at 13:09:11 UTC,
with complete reported pagination. It is non-atomic and not exhaustive novelty
proof; the actual closest proofs/code supply the scoped comparison above.
Earlier searches and runs remain historical provenance. Canonical main and
the #4586/#4588/#4591 heads were rechecked unchanged before publication.
Package-local LOCAL-ONLY notes record the pre-publication state; this PR
provides the public artifact without claiming scientific acceptance.

No global batching optimality, tight width lower bound, new leaf exponent,
κ, convergence theorem, practical threshold or physical/routing/precision/
stock/tape admission. Native semantics, whole-job contracts, analytic transfer
and recovery remain inherited premises.

Credit Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Mihir Srivastava, Ryanson Jonathan, Cinna Davis
and the retained lineage, with complementary #4586/#4588/#4591 work credited
above. Prepared for codyw912 with substantial OpenAI and Anthropic assistance.
Retained scientific sources keep their own notices; new material is Apache-2.0.

## Current publication revision

The PR now adds only the two scoped research packages; scientific code,
receipts and source pins are unchanged.

An independent Anthropic review approved the environment-boundary correction.
Both registered hooks passed again through the retained local environment in
74.79 seconds, including normal/optimized commands. Committed-byte and
source-history checks passed at this head: 19 adaptive files and 12 default
files. Earlier export/integrity checks belong to commit `420b7ba9249e`.
No human/proof-kernel acceptance or hosted CI success is claimed.
